title: Two-set Venn diagram
prompt:
In a group of 120 students, 70 take Accounting, 45 take Economics and 25 take both.
- How many take only Accounting?
- How many take at least one of the two?
- How many take neither?
solution:
Draw two circles. Put 25 in the overlap.

Only Accounting = 70 − 25 = **45**; only Economics = 45 − 25 = 20.

n(A ∪ B) = 70 + 45 − 25 = **90**.

Neither = 120 − 90 = **30**.

title: Survey with two sets
prompt:
In a group of 200 students, 124 take coffee, 96 take tea and 48 take both.
- How many take only coffee?
- How many take at least one of the two?
- How many take neither?
solution:
Draw two circles. Put 48 in the overlap.

Only coffee = 124 − 48 = **76**; only tea = 96 − 48 = 48.

n(A ∪ B) = 124 + 96 − 48 = **172**.

Neither = 200 − 172 = **28**.

title: Three-set Venn diagram
prompt:
Of 120 people surveyed: 60 read news (N), 50 watch TV (T), 40 listen to radio (R); 20 do N and T, 15 do N and R, 10 do T and R, and 5 do all three.
- How many use at least one?
- How many use none?
- How many use only N?

title: Counting subsets
prompt:
Let S = {a, b, c, d, e, f}.
- How many subsets does S have?
- How many proper subsets?
- How many subsets have exactly 2 elements?
solution:
n = 6, so there are 2⁶ = **64** subsets.

Proper subsets exclude S itself: 64 − 1 = **63**.

Two-element subsets: C(6,2) = 6×5 ÷ 2 = **15**.

title: Reading a three-set diagram
prompt:

title: De Morgan's law
prompt:

- Find n(A ∪ B).
- Find n(A).
- Find n(B).

title: Sports survey
prompt:
In a group of 150 students, 82 take football, 61 take basketball and 30 take both.
- How many take only football?
- How many take at least one of the two?
- How many take neither?
solution:
Draw two circles. Put 30 in the overlap.

Only football = 82 − 30 = **52**; only basketball = 61 − 30 = 31.

n(A ∪ B) = 82 + 61 − 30 = **113**.

Neither = 150 − 113 = **37**.

title: Cartesian product
